description.en: Baculites-inspired preserved shell specimen only: a nearly straight tapering compressed section with a real wall, broad elliptical aperture and a bounded inner chamber. Quiet original shell surface, not an internal-mold suture pattern used as external decoration. No solid round rod, plant stem, unsupported living soft parts or tentacles; no specimen/model copying.
description.zh: Baculites启发保存壳标本：近直渐细扁截面、真实壳壁与较宽椭圆壳口和有限内腔；安静原创壳面，不把内模缝合线当外饰。非实心圆棍/植物茎，不加活体软组织触手，不复制标本模型。
